build_twelvelabs_embedding_request: build a TwelveLabs Marengo embedding request from OpenAI-style input with text, image, video, or audio
map_openai_params_to_bedrock: map OpenAI embedding parameters like encoding_format and input_type to Bedrock TwelveLabs Marengo format
get_supported_openai_params: get the list of OpenAI parameters supported by the TwelveLabs Marengo embedding config
transform_response_to_openai: transform a TwelveLabs Marengo embedding response to OpenAI EmbeddingResponse format
transform_async_invoke_response: transform an AWS Bedrock async invoke invocationArn response to OpenAI EmbeddingResponse format
